name: Password Reset Code
description: Sent when a user requests a password reset code via email.
subject: #if (${sourcename})Your account password reset code is ${token}#{else}Your password reset code is ${token}#end
body:
Password Reset Code

Dear ${user.name},

#if (${sourcename})

A request has been made to reset your ${sourcename} account password. If you made this request, copy the following code into the prompt in ${PRODUCT_NAME} to verify your identity:

#{else}

A request has been made to reset your ${PRODUCT_NAME} password. If you made this request, copy the following code into the prompt in ${PRODUCT_NAME} to verify your identity:

#end

Your verification code is ${token}.

This code expires as soon as it is used, or on ${expires}.

If you did not make this request, contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
